summary: This informational RFC registers the media type used by the Content Delivery Network Interconnection protocol suite. It explains the registration process and how to use the required payload-type parameter, which says what kind of CDNI data an object contains.

eli5.summary: Every package needs a label saying what is inside. This creates the official label that CDN-to-CDN messages use and explains how to fill it out.

questions: what is the cdni ptype parameter
how do i register a cdni payload type
subtitle: One shared media type, application/cdni, that labels every kind of message passed between interconnected CDNs.

tldr.problem: The CDNI protocols carry many kinds of JSON and logging payloads over HTTP, and registering a separate media type for each object would be unwieldy.
tldr.mechanism: RFC 7736 registers a single media type, application/cdni, with a required ptype parameter that names the payload type, and creates an IANA registry of valid ptype values.
tldr.outcome: New payload types are added by Specification Required review by a designated expert, and the registry starts out empty.

today: RFC 7736 is an Informational RFC and the unit metadata shows no RFC that obsoletes or updates it. It defines the media type and the registry that CDNI protocol specifications use for their payload types.

sections.title: Introduction and Scope
sections.content:
The CDNI working group develops protocols that let multiple content delivery networks (CDNs) interconnect. The suite consists of several HTTP-based interfaces, many carrying payloads encoded in JSON: Control, Footprint and Capabilities Advertisement, Request Routing Redirection, Metadata and Logging.

It is desirable to indicate the type of object in the HTTP entity-body without registering a separate media type for each CDNI object. So this document defines one new media type with a required ptype parameter, plus a registry of payload types. The same payload type may also be used as a reference elsewhere, for example to point to metadata objects from capability advertisements.
sections.eli5: Instead of making a new kind of sticker for every kind of parcel, CDNI makes one sticker with a blank to fill in saying what is inside.

sections.title: The application/cdni Media Type
sections.content:
The registration uses type name application and subtype cdni. It has one required parameter, ptype, which describes the type of CDNI message in the payload as registered in the CDNI Payload Types registry. There are no optional parameters.

The messages may be 8bit or binary, and generic logging information may be 7bit or binary. The intended usage is LIMITED USE, and the media type is meant only for CDNI protocol message exchanges. Interconnected CDNs use it for sharing configuration and logging data and for issuing content management and redirection requests. The author and change controller are the IETF CDNI working group.
sections.eli5: The label always says application/cdni, and it must have a ptype blank filled in so the receiver knows how to read what is inside.

sections.title: The Payload Types Registry
sections.content:
IANA created a CDNI Payload Types subregistry inside the Content Delivery Network Interconnection (CDNI) Parameters registry. It defines the valid values of ptype. A payload type is an ASCII string of visible characters that excludes equal signs, double quotes and semicolons, and it will not exceed 256 characters.

Additions require Specification Required. A designated expert checks that a new type does not duplicate existing ones, prevents gratuitous additions, and prevents additions that would hurt interoperability. The specification must show a reasonably defined purpose tied to a CDNI interface, include a reasonable relationship to at least one Standards Track CDNI interface, and give enough encoding detail for interoperable parsers. The registry will initially be unpopulated.
sections.eli5: A librarian keeps the list of allowed labels. Before adding a new one, the librarian checks that it is not a copy of an old one and that it is explained well enough for everyone to use.

sections.title: Security Considerations
sections.content:
CDNI interfaces that return encoded data may be misinterpreted by non-CDNI or non-compliant implementations. CDNI logging information is likely to carry large amounts of data that may overload unexpecting clients.

Because application/cdni is generic, proper validation requires parsing and understanding the ptype parameter and its data encoding. Failing to validate properly may allow data extrusion under the cover of this media type. The individual CDNI interface specifications define the authentication, authorization, confidentiality, integrity and privacy requirements for each interface.
sections.eli5: A label alone does not make a parcel safe. The receiver has to check the contents really match the label.

data.title: CDNI payload type
data.code:
ptype = 1*256(ptype-char)
ptype-char = %x21 / %x23-3A / %x3C / %x3E-7E
  ; Includes ALPHA, DIGIT, and other printables
  ; Excludes equal signs (=), double quotes ("), semicolons (;)
